context: A weathered fishing pier in Kyushu, early morning. Hina is visiting Grandpa Goro. She has been holding a rod for an hour and caught nothing.
purpose: cross-generational instruction — patience as a small life lesson, mostly through silence

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: おじいちゃん、まだ、なんも来ない…
lines.style: Half-whine, half-genuine. Bouncing a little on the pier.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.style: Two letters. Doesn't look up. Kyushu drawl.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Tries doubt as a strategy. Lifts the rod doubtfully.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.style: One word. Total certainty. Doesn't elaborate.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: じゃあ、なんで来ないの？
lines.style: Genuine kid-logic question. Sits down on the pier in the voice.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: 魚の時間や、こっちの時間ちゃう。
lines.style: Slow, considered. Kyushu inflection. A small offered truth.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: A real beat. The kid is actually considering it. Tilts her head in the voice.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.style: Even softer than the previous line. An invitation, not a scolding.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: A whole-body listening. No words, just attention focused.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.style: Points without lifting his arm much. The first new information of the morning.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: A breath of discovery. Voice almost a whisper, then louder on the second 「うん」.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.style: Slightly proud — not of the fish, of her seeing. Voice low.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Smaller than her earlier doubt. A whole different word.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.style: The most words he'll say today. Settles back in the voice.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Quietest line in the conversation. She gets it now.
